Bulletin No: 01 TCA/26/02/22/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for the low pressure area over Southwest Bay of Bengal.
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre, Department of Meteorology.
Issued at 1.00 p.m. on 22 January 2026
For fishermen and naval communities engaged in marine activities in
the Bay of Bengal, northeast of Sri Lanka.
PLEASE BE AWARE!
The atmospheric disturbance that prevailed over the Bay of Bengal has developed into a low-
pressure area and is currently located to the northeast of Sri Lanka. Under the influence of this
system, heavy showers or thundershowers, Strong wind gust about (50-60) kmph, may occur
in the sea areas marked on the map below, and the mentioned sea areas may be rough.
Navel and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and
bulletins issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
